title: serviceable solid-state lighting fixtures

specimens.name: Sealed linear LED work-light bar
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Long thick rectangular work light, full frosted diffuser, rugged endcaps and mounting feet.

specimens.name: Recessed LED downlight can
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Round shallow recessed fixture with circular flange, inset diffuser and compact rear housing.

specimens.name: Adjustable task-light spot
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Short cylindrical directional head with stepped heat fins and one compact attached pivot bracket.

specimens.name: Waterproof surface light strip
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Very narrow short flexible strip segment in translucent sealed encapsulation, flush mounting profile. No reel.

specimens.name: Asymmetric anti-glare service optic
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Compact rectangular service light optic with distinctly slanted asymmetric reflector and a dark physical cutoff baffle.

specimens.name: Replaceable LED light-engine cartridge
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Small square metal-backed emitter cartridge with exposed unlit emitter chips and a visible copper thermal slug.

specimens.name: Protected floor-edge marker fixture
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Low wedge-shaped protected fixture with one narrow sealed amber lens along its front edge.

specimens.name: Backup emergency luminaire
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One isolated unpowered physical specimen. Compact bulkhead luminaire with broad frosted lens above a separate visible battery-access seam and captive latch.

global_forbidden: text, captions, logos, labels, title, footer or printed style instructions anywhere
emitted light, glow, beams or active indicators
duplicate or extra objects, detached accessories, scenes or installations
E2 bulky incandescent housings and exposed cabling
E4 or E5 futuristic glowing or holographic hardware

era_contract.character: E3 2015 modular spaceport service lighting: warm off-white housings, graphite seals, passive heat sinking and replaceable solid-state modules, HD pixel art.
required_signals: Exactly eight unpowered specimens in order in the 4 by 2 grid
Distinguish the rigid work bar with endcaps from the narrow encapsulated strip
Each fixture identifiable through its optics, mount, or service interface
Canvas contains only specimens and plain background, style text is instruction only
replaced_previous_language: Preserve protected lenses and service access
Replace bulky E2 lamps with shallow LED optics, heat paths and sealed low-profile construction
Add cartridge replacement and separate battery service for compact field maintenance
forbidden_regressions: Exposed wires, deep lamp housings, recolor-only change
Visible emitted light or scene effects
